explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration with this result. The theorem says that if an additive character ψ of the adic completion F_v is trivial on the integers O_v but not trivial on elements of valuation ≤ exp 1, then the set of y with ψ(zy) = 1 for all z in O_v is exactly O_v. I searched Mathlib for `AddChar` used together with `adicCompletion` and found nothing. In `Mathlib/NumberTheory`, `AddChar` only appears in files about ZMod, Gauss sums, Jacobi sums, L-series, cusps of modular forms and p-adic characters (`Padics/AddChar`). None of these covers dual lattices or conductors of characters on adic completions. The proof uses only basic valuation facts (`mem_adicCompletionIntegers`, `map_div₀`, `WithZero.exp_le_exp`, `mul_mem`) together with its own argument.
